name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys Llewellyn is a seasoned security professional with a career spanning over two decades, the last fifteen of which have been dedicated to motorsport. His journey began in law enforcement, where he honed his skills in risk assessment and crisis management before transitioning into the high-octane world of racing. Rhys's meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to safety were quickly recognized, leading him to prominent roles in various racing teams.

Rhys joined Proton by Premotion with a singular goal: to establish an impregnable security protocol, safeguarding the team's assets, personnel, and competitive edge. His leadership style emphasizes proactive measures, fostering a culture of vigilance and accountability among his security team. Known for his sharp eye for detail and relentless pursuit of perfection, Rhys leaves no stone unturned in his mission to ensure the team's success, both on and off the track. His Welsh heritage instills a deep sense of community and loyalty, making him a respected and trusted figure within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Rhys is a stocky man with a weathered face that reflects years of experience.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of double-checking every lock and seal, even when others have already verified it.
Insists on drinking only Welsh tea, even when traveling internationally.
